description: Creates a commit in a GitLab project with multiple file operations, including creating, updating, deleting, moving, and changing permissions. An optional force setting can overwrite the target branch with a new commit history.

actions.description: List of file operations to perform in this commit. Each action represents a file change (create, update, delete, move, or chmod).

items.description: Represents a single file operation within a commit.

action.description: The type of action to perform on the file.
action.title: Action

content.description: File content. Required for 'create' and 'update' actions. Optional for 'move' action (preserves existing content if omitted).
content.title: Content

encoding.description: Content encoding type. Use 'base64' for binary files. Defaults to 'text'.
encoding.title: Encoding

execute_filemode.description: Set file execute permissions. Required when action is 'chmod'.
execute_filemode.title: Execute Filemode

file_path.description: Full path to the file being modified.
file_path.title: File Path

last_commit_id.description: Last known commit ID for this file. Used to detect conflicts for 'update', 'move', and 'delete' actions.
last_commit_id.title: Last Commit Id

previous_path.description: Original file path. Required when action is 'move'.
previous_path.title: Previous Path

items.title: CommitAction

actions.title: Actions

author_email.description: Author email address for the commit. Defaults to the authenticated user's email.
author_email.title: Author Email

author_name.description: Author name for the commit. Defaults to the authenticated user's name.
author_name.title: Author Name

branch.description: Target branch name where the commit will be created.
branch.title: Branch

commit_message.description: The commit message describing the changes.
commit_message.title: Commit Message

force.description: When true, overwrites the target branch with a new commit history. Use with caution as this rewrites Git history.
force.title: Force

project_id.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.
project_id.title: Project Id

start_branch.description: Name of the branch to start the new commit from. If not provided, uses the target branch.
start_branch.title: Start Branch

start_project.description: Project ID or URL-encoded path of the source project for the parent commit. Used when creating commits from another project's branch.
start_project.title: Start Project

start_sha.description: SHA of the commit to start the new commit from. Must be a 40-character SHA-1 hash.
start_sha.title: Start Sha

stats.description: Include commit statistics (additions, deletions, total) in the response. Defaults to true.
stats.title: Stats

name: create_commit

CommitStats.description: Statistics about the changes in a commit.
CommitStats.title: CommitStats

authored_date.description: The date when the commit was authored in ISO 8601 format.
authored_date.title: Authored Date

committed_date.description: The date when the commit was committed in ISO 8601 format.
committed_date.title: Committed Date

created_at.description: The date when the commit was created in ISO 8601 format.
created_at.title: Created At

id.description: The full SHA of the commit.
id.title: Id

last_pipeline.description: Information about the last pipeline associated with this commit.
last_pipeline.title: Last Pipeline

project_id.description: The ID of the project this commit belongs to.
project_id.title: Project Id

short_id.description: The short SHA of the commit.
short_id.title: Short Id

title.description: The commit title (first line of commit message).
title.title: Title

trailers.description: Git trailers parsed from the commit message.
trailers.title: Trailers

web_url.description: The URL to view the commit in the GitLab web interface.
web_url.title: Web Url

LastPipeline.description: Information about the last pipeline associated with a commit.
LastPipeline.title: LastPipeline
